verdict.rationale: Semgrep's core operation is running rule sets across entire codebases/monorepos in one scan, and Managed Scans explicitly supports bulk onboarding and scanning many repositories at once without CI changes; the AppSec Platform API also lets you list findings/projects across an entire deployment in bulk. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence confirming bulk operations perform well at very large scale (community notes some performance slowdowns on large rulesets/codebases), and no explicit documentation of bulk API write operations (e.g., bulk triage/ignore across many findings).
